completeness.why: All five provider link functions keep only their bank lookup and pass their own data to linkBankSyncAccount, which takes the upgrade-or-insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence; the preserved variations (file id, Akahu's tables, GoCardless mask/official name) are explicit arguments, and EnableBanking's unreachable null check is dropped.

interface.why: fileId, syncTables and accountFields cleanly name the preserved inconsistencies; minor costs are the loosely typed Partial<DbAccount> accountFields, which makes every caller repeat the offbudget mapping, and separate bankId/syncBankId where the bank row could be passed.
